qualification: Isolated DC functional comparison supports the current V1/V6/V19/V20 NPN C/E assignment; it does not qualify 1SC60A or 1SA20C electrical parameters or finish the independent source netlist

source.branch: V6, V19 and V20 have lower-right leads on 00, while R37, R39 and R38 pull their respective upper-right leads toward 12P. R40 couples V19 upper-right to V20 base. Separately V1 upper-right meets 35P, its lower-right drives KRS, R2 returns KRS to 00, and R1/R3/R4 set its base from 35P and the 9 V reference.

fixture.assumptions: Ideal 12, 35 and 9 V rails; 0 and 3 V V6 base drive through 1 kohm; V1 R4 trim 22, 1100 or 2200 ohm. Generic silicon BJT IS=1e-14 A, VAF=60 V and BF=18, 26 or 34.7. The BF range was borrowed from the former provisional SSY20A neck profile only to test polarity sensitivity, not asserted for either printed type or the later BC546B-class proxy. No dynamic loading or reverse base-emitter breakdown is modeled.

results_v1.reversed_npn_caveat: The reversed NPN places its emitter at 35 V while its base is about 19.5-22.1 V, reverse-biasing the base-emitter junction by roughly 13-15 V; the generic SPICE model omits reverse base-emitter breakdown. Its reported KRS voltage is not a qualified operating point.
results_v1.interpretation: The assembled NPN orientation yields an adjustable KRS emitter-follower voltage with the printed 35P/KRS/9 V connections. The PNP orientation leaves KRS pinned near 35 V across the trim range; the reversed NPN result is outside this fixture's validated model domain.

status: A1 functional DC polarity check passed for V1/V6/V19/V20 under the recorded ideal-rail assumptions. Printed arrow reading, remaining page-3/4 independent netlist, V5 and vertical-board 1SA20C instances, model identity and connected stress remain open. The isolated result is not an A2 device-model qualification or an A3 waveform score.
